**command.cpp registers engine-console commands for bot spawning, clan-tag updates, dvar/command inspection, memory and rawfile extraction, Scaleform discovery, and gametype debugging.**

## Role and Architecture

`command::component` integrates command registration with the component lifecycle through `component_interface`, `REGISTER_COMPONENT(command::component)`, and `scheduler::once(..., scheduler::main)`.

`handlers` stores lowercase command names as `std::unordered_map<std::string, std::function<void(params&)>>`; `add()` installs one engine callback per command name through `game::Cmd_AddCommandInternal`, then dispatches subsequent invocations through `main_handler()`.

`cmd_allocator` owns `game::cmd_function_s` allocations and is released by `component::pre_destroy()`.

`main_handler()` lowercases `params[0]`, looks up `handlers`, and invokes the matching callback; unknown commands are ignored.

## Exported Interface

`command::params::params()` captures the current engine command nesting index from `*game::command_id`.

`int command::params::size() const` returns `game::cmd_argc[nesting_]`.

`const char* command::params::get(int index) const` returns `game::cmd_argv[nesting_][index]`, or `""` when `index >= size()`; negative indices are not explicitly rejected.

`std::string command::params::join(int index) const` joins arguments from `index` through `size() - 1` with literal spaces.

`std::vector<std::string> command::params::get_all() const` copies every current command argument into a vector.

`void command::add_raw(const char* name, void (*callback)())` registers an engine-native callback using `game::Cmd_AddCommandInternal(name, callback, cmd_allocator.allocate<game::cmd_function_s>())`.

`void command::add(const char* name, const std::function<void(const params&)>& callback)` lowercases `name`, registers `main_handler` if the command is new, and stores the callback in `handlers`.

`void command::add(const char* name, const std::function<void()>& callback)` adapts a no-argument callback to `std::function<void(const params&)>`.

`void command::execute(std::string command)` appends `"\n"` and queues the command through `game::Cbuf_AddText(0, command.data())`.

`command::component::post_load()` schedules initialization and registration of all built-in console commands on `scheduler::main`.

`command::component::pre_destroy()` calls `cmd_allocator.clear()`.

## Runtime Constants and Engine Memory Contracts

`CLIENT_STRIDE` is `688916`; `get_client(int index)` computes `get_clients_base() + index * CLIENT_STRIDE`.

`CLIENT_REAL_PLAYER_OFFSET` is `0x20`; `is_bot_client(int index)` treats a client as a bot when its connection state is at least `game::CS_CONNECTED` and the integer at `client + 0x20` equals `0`.

`CLIENT_USERINFO_OFFSET` is `1604`; `rename_new_bot_client()` reads and rewrites userinfo at `get_client(i) + 1604`.

`CLIENT_USERINFO_SIZE` is `1024`; `rename_new_bot_client()` zeroes 1024 bytes and copies at most `CLIENT_USERINFO_SIZE - 1` bytes before calling `game::SV_ClientUserinfoChanged(i)`.

`ACTIVE_PROFILE_INDEX` is `0`; `update_clan_name_state()` updates profile index `0`.

`BOT_NAMES_FILE` is `"consolation/bots.txt"`; `load_bot_names()` reads this relative to the game executable working path through `utils::io::read_file`.

`LIVE_CLAN_TARGET_PRIMARY` is `0x111CF170`; `LIVE_CLAN_TARGET_SECONDARY` is `0x111F1C00`; `update_clan_name_state()` resolves both with `game::game_offset()` and calls `game::Live_UpdateClan`.

`CLAN_DIRTY_FLAGS` is `0x1149E6BC`; `update_clan_name_state()` resolves it and ORs the pointed `std::uint32_t` with `2u`.

`GAMETYPES_RAWFILE` is `"maps/mp/gametypes/_gametypes.txt"`; `dumpGametypes` passes it to `dump_rawfile()`.

`get_clients_base()` dereferences `game::game_offset(0x11CA5D8C)` as the client-array base pointer.

`get_max_clients()` reads dvar `"sv_maxclients"`, clamps it to at least `1`, and falls back to `18`.

## Parsing, Paths, and File I/O

`parse_integer(const char* value, std::uintptr_t* result)` rejects null, empty, or invalid strings; it uses base `10`, switches to base `16` for `0x`/`0X` prefixes or any hexadecimal letters `a-fA-F`, and requires `std::strtoull()` to consume the entire input.

`resolve_address(std::uintptr_t parsed)` treats values in `[0x10000000, 0x20000000)` as IDA/game addresses and maps them with `game::game_offset()`; other values remain runtime pointers.

`append_format(std::string& output, const char* format, ...)` formats into a 256-byte buffer with `vsnprintf_s(..., _TRUNCATE, ...)`, so formatted lines are truncated at 255 bytes.

`get_exe_directory()` obtains the executable path through `GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, path, sizeof(path))`, rejects zero or oversized results, and removes the final `/` or `\` component.

`resolve_game_path(const std::string& path)` preserves paths with a drive prefix at `path[1] == ':'`; other paths receive the executable directory plus `"\\"`.

`create_directory_tree(const std::string& path, DWORD* error)` creates each slash-delimited parent using `CreateDirectoryA`, accepts `ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS`, and stores `GetLastError()` through `error` on failure.

`write_file_noexcept(const std::string& path, const std::string& data, DWORD* error)` resolves the path, creates parents, writes with `CreateFileA(..., GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, ..., CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, ...)`, caps the write size at `MAXDWORD`, requires `WriteFile()` and exact byte count, and closes the handle.

`normalize_rawfile_path(std::string path)` converts `\` to `/`.

`get_file_name(std::string path)` normalizes separators and returns the substring after the final `/`.

`make_dump_safe_path(std::string path)` normalizes separators and strips all leading `/` characters before constructing dump paths.

## Memory Dumping

`is_readable_memory(const void* address, std::size_t length)` uses `VirtualQuery()` and accepts committed regions with `PAGE_READONLY`, `PAGE_READWRITE`, `PAGE_WRITECOPY`, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READ`, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`, or `PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY`; it requires `start + length <= region_end`.

`safe_read_byte(std::uintptr_t address, unsigned char* value)` reads one byte with `ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), ...)` and requires exactly `sizeof(*value)` bytes.

`dump_memory(const char* address_text, const char* length_text, const char* output_name)` implements `dumpMemory <address> [length] [output]`; default length is `0x100`, accepted length is clamped to `[1, 0x4000]`, and only the first byte is validated with `is_readable_memory()`.

`dump_memory()` emits hexadecimal rows using exact formats `"%08X  "` and `"%02X "`, substitutes `"?? "` and `'?'` for failed byte reads, renders printable ASCII for bytes `32 <= byte < 127`, and terminates rows with `"\r\n"`.

`dump_memory()` defaults output to `"consolation/memory_dump/%08X.txt"`; explicit output names are appended to `"consolation/memory_dump/"`, then written by `write_file_noexcept()`.

`dump_memory()` prints exact usage text `"dumpMemory <address> [length] [output]: dump readable memory to consolation/memory_dump\n"` and `"dumpMemory accepts IDA addresses like 0x113D1684 or runtime pointers\n"` when no address is supplied.

## Rawfile and Scaleform Extraction

`get_rawfile_buffer(const game::RawFile* rawfile)` returns text data without a trailing NUL when `rawfile->len > 0` and the final byte is `'\0'`; null assets or buffers return `{}`.

`get_rawfile_binary_buffer(const game::RawFile* rawfile)` returns all `rawfile->len` bytes, including NUL bytes, and rejects null, missing buffers, or zero lengths.

`dump_rawfile(const char* rawfile_name, const char* output_name)` normalizes the asset name, resolves it with `game::DB_FindXAssetHeader(game::ASSET_TYPE_RAWFILE, ...)`, and writes text data through `utils::io::write_file()`.

`dump_rawfile()` defaults to `"consolation/rawfile_dump/" + normalized_name`; explicit output names use `"consolation/" + output_name`.

`dump_rawfile()` prints `"dumpRawFile <rawfile> [output]: dump a rawfile asset to consolation/rawfile_dump\n"` without an asset name and warns with `"dumpRawFile: rawfile '%s' was empty or unavailable\n"` for unavailable data.

`dump_rawfile_binary(const game::RawFile* rawfile, const char* output_prefix)` writes binary data to `output_prefix + make_dump_safe_path(rawfile->name)` through `write_file_noexcept()`.

`dump_swf_by_name(const char* swf_name)` enumerates loaded `game::ASSET_TYPE_RAWFILE` assets via `fastfiles::enum_assets(..., true)`, compares lowercased basenames against the requested name, and accepts `.swf` to `.gfx` fallback conversion.

`dump_swf_by_name()` writes matches under `"consolation/scaleform_dump/"`, reports `"dumpSwf: dumped %s to %s\n"`, and warns `"dumpSwf: '%s' was not found in loaded Scaleform rawfile assets\n"` when no match exists.

`dump_scaleform_shared_files()` searches exact names `cmsharedplatform.gfx`, `cmsharedlibrary.gfx`, `pcsharedlibrary.gfx`, `mpsharedlibrary.gfx`, `cmfont1_glyphs.gfx`, `cmfont2_glyphs.gfx`, `cmfont3_glyphs.gfx`, `cmfont4_glyphs.gfx`, and `cmfont5_glyphs.gfx`, then reports `"dumpScaleformSharedFiles: dumped %i file(s)\n"`.

`is_scaleform_asset_candidate(const char* asset_name)` lowercases normalized names and matches `.gfx`, `.swf`, `scaleform`, `mpsysmodeselect`, `mpxbplaylistselect`, `cmsharedplatform`, `gfxfontlib`, `pcsharedlibrary`, or `cmsharedlibrary`.

`get_info_value(const std::string& info, const std::string& key)` parses backslash-delimited key/value strings such as `\name\value\clanAbbrev\CSL` and returns the first matching value.

`set_info_value(std::string& info, const std::string& key, const std::string& value)` parses the same structure, replaces the first matching key or appends a new pair, and rebuilds every pair with leading `\`.

`trim_bot_name(std::string name)` removes trailing `\r`, `\n`, spaces, and tabs, then removes leading spaces and tabs.

`load_bot_names()` clears `bot_names`, reads `BOT_NAMES_FILE`, and stores every nonempty trimmed line.

`next_bot_number` starts at `1`; `get_next_bot_name()` cycles through `bot_names` using `(next_bot_number - 1) % bot_names.size()` or generates `std::format("consolation_bot{}", next_bot_number++ - 1)` when no names are loaded.

`normalize_clan_name(const std::string& raw_value)` keeps at most four characters, converts `'^'` to a space, skips bytes below `32`, and preserves other bytes without game-color parsing.

`get_dvar_string(game::dvar_s* dvar)` returns `dvar->current.string` or `""` for null dvars/null strings.

`update_clan_name_state(const std::string& clan_name)` calls `game::Dvar_SetString("clanName", ...)`, `game::GamerProfile_UpdateProfileFromDvars(0, 1)`, both `game::Live_UpdateClan()` targets, and sets dirty flag bit `2u`.

`rename_new_bot_client()` scans `get_max_clients()`, selects bot clients whose `"name"` begins with `"bot"` via `rfind("bot", 0) == 0`, sets `"name"` to `get_next_bot_name()`, sets `"clanAbbrev"` to `"CSL"`, rewrites userinfo, and returns the slot or `-1`.

## Registered Commands

`addbot [count]` validates `game::SV_AddTestClient`, reloads `BOT_NAMES_FILE`, defaults `count` to `1`, rejects `count <= 0`, spawns test clients, renames them, and reports server-full or userinfo failures.

`clanName <tag>` reads or sets dvar `"clanName"`; setting applies `normalize_clan_name()` and `update_clan_name_state()`.

`dvarDump [filename]` prints all `*game::dvarCount` entries from `game::sortedDvars`; optional output is `"consolation/" + filename` with `.txt` appended when absent.

`dvarDump` serializes each line with `std::format("{} \"{}\"\r\n", dvar->name, dvars::Dvar_ValueToString(dvar, dvar->current))`, writes append mode based on `i != 0`, and catches formatting exceptions because empty dvars can crash string conversion.

`commandDump [filename]` traverses `*game::cmd_functions`, prints command names, and optionally writes `"{}\\r\\n"`-formatted lines to `"consolation/" + filename`, appending `.txt` when absent.

`dumpRawFile <rawfile> [output]` delegates to `dump_rawfile()`.

`dumpSwf <name.swf|name.gfx>` delegates to `dump_swf_by_name()`.

`dumpScaleformSharedFiles` delegates to `dump_scaleform_shared_files()`.

`findScaleformAssets [filter]` delegates to `find_scaleform_assets()`.

`dumpGametypes` dumps `GAMETYPES_RAWFILE`.

`dumpGametypesDebug` calls `gametypes::dump_debug_state()` and reports `"dumpGametypesDebug: unhandled exception\n"` on failure.

`refreshGametypes` calls `gametypes::force_refresh_ui_gametype_list()` and reports `"refreshGametypes: unhandled exception\n"` on failure.

`dumpMemory <address> [length] [output]` delegates to `dump_memory()` inside a catch-all boundary and reports `"dumpMemory: unhandled exception\n"`.

`listassetpool <poolnumber> [filter]` lists valid asset pools or enumerates one pool through `fastfiles::enum_assets(type, ..., true)`; filters use `console::match_compare(filter, asset_name, false)`.

`game::game_offset()` couples address parsing, client memory, clan globals, and executable-specific offsets to the game build.

`game::DB_FindXAssetHeader()`, `game::DB_GetXAssetName()`, `game::XAssetHeader`, `game::XAsset`, `game::g_assetNames`, and `fastfiles::enum_assets()` couple asset inspection to the engine asset database.

`utils::io::read_file()`, `utils::io::write_file()`, `CreateFileA()`, `WriteFile()`, `VirtualQuery()`, and `ReadProcessMemory()` couple command behavior to Windows filesystem and process-memory APIs.

`dvars::Dvar_ValueToString()` is wrapped in `try/catch (...)` inside `dvarDump`; `dumpGametypesDebug`, `refreshGametypes`, and `dumpMemory` also use catch-all exception boundaries.

`write_file_noexcept()` is non-throwing by convention but can overwrite existing files through `CREATE_ALWAYS`; explicit output names are not sanitized beyond path resolution, while binary rawfile names pass through `make_dump_safe_path()`.

`is_readable_memory()` validates only one queried memory region and `dump_memory()` checks only the initial byte before reading later addresses individually with `safe_read_byte()`.

`handlers`, `bot_names`, and `next_bot_number` are process-global mutable state; command dispatch and bot naming assume main-thread execution established by `scheduler::main`.

entries.response:
**game.cpp does runtime bridging between the project and the 32-bit `jb_mp_s.dll` game engine.**

## Public symbols

- `HMODULE mp_dll` caches the resolved `jb_mp_s.dll` module handle, initialized to `nullptr`.
- `uintptr_t game_offset(uintptr_t ida_address)` lazily resolves `mp_dll` via `GetModuleHandleA("jb_mp_s.dll")`, asserts success, and rebases IDA addresses with `ida_address - 0x10000000 + reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mp_dll)`.
- `void Cbuf_AddText(int controller, const char* text)` calls engine address `0x103F5180` with `text` in `eax` and `controller` in `ecx`.
- `void CL_KeyEvent(int localClientNum, int key, int down, unsigned int time)` calls `0x1031A680` using `ecx` for `localClientNum` and stack args `time`, `down`, `key`.
- `cmd_function_s* Cmd_FindCommand(const char* name)` traverses `*cmd_functions`, compares names with `strcmp`, and returns the matching node or `0`.
- `void Cmd_AddCommandInternal(const char* name, void(__cdecl* function)(), cmd_function_s* cmd)` rejects duplicate functional commands through `console::error`, otherwise prepends `cmd` to `*cmd_functions` and logs via `console::debug`.
- `DB_XAssetGetNameHandler_t* DB_XAssetGetNameHandler` aliases rebased engine data at `0x1055E470`.
- `const char* DB_GetXAssetName(game::XAsset* asset)` returns `""` for null assets, asserts `asset->header.data`, and dispatches `DB_XAssetGetNameHandler[asset->type]`.
- `bool DB_IsXAssetDefault(XAssetType type, const char* name)` invokes engine address `0x103DFC00`; `name` is accepted but not passed by the inline assembly.
- `void DB_EnumXAssetEntries(XAssetType type, std::function<void(XAssetEntryPoolEntry*)> callback, bool overrides)` enumerates matching hashed assets and optional override chains.
- `unsigned int Scr_GetFunctionHandle(const char* filename, const char* funcHandle)` calls `0x1022E410` and returns the engine handle.
- `void RemoveRefToObject(unsigned int obj)` calls `0x10230DB0` with `obj` in `edi`.
- `__int16 Scr_ExecThread(int handle)` calls `0x1023B960` and returns `ax`.
- `int Scr_LoadScript(const char* name)` calls `0x1022E7C0` with `name` in `ecx`.
- `ScreenPlacement ScrPlace_GetViewPlacement()` returns `*game::scrPlaceView`.
- `Font_s* R_RegisterFont(const char* font)` resolves `ASSET_TYPE_FONT` through `DB_FindXAssetHeader`.
- `Material* Material_RegisterHandle(const char* material)` resolves `ASSET_TYPE_MATERIAL` through `DB_FindXAssetHeader`.
- `dvar_s* Dvar_FindMalleableVar(const char* dvarName)` hashes `dvarName` with `generateHashValue`, traverses `dvarHashTable`, and performs case-insensitive matching with `stricmp`.
- `dvar_s* Dvar_FindVar(const char* dvarName)` delegates directly to `Dvar_FindMalleableVar`.
- `void Dvar_SetString(const char* dvarName, const char* value)` calls `0x10278FD0`.
- `void GamerProfile_UpdateProfileFromDvars(int profileIndex, int updateState)` calls `0x102439B0` with two stack arguments.
- `void Live_UpdateClan(int object, const char* clan)` calls `0x10324960`.
- `dvar_s* Dvar_RegisterBool(const char* name, bool value, int flags, const char* desc)` calls `0x10278E60` and returns the engine-created dvar.
- `unsigned int Scr_GetNumParam()` returns `*scr_numParams`.

## Engine coupling and invariants

- `Cbuf_AddText`, `CL_KeyEvent`, `DB_IsXAssetDefault`, `Scr_GetFunctionHandle`, `RemoveRefToObject`, `Scr_ExecThread`, `Scr_LoadScript`, `Dvar_SetString`, `GamerProfile_UpdateProfileFromDvars`, `Live_UpdateClan`, and `Dvar_RegisterBool` depend on x86 MSVC `__asm`, fixed IDA offsets, and engine-specific register/stack conventions.
- `DB_EnumXAssetEntries` increments the rebased lock at `0x1056250A`, waits while `0x105624F8` is nonzero using `std::this_thread::sleep_for(1ms)`, scans exactly `0x9C40` hash buckets, invokes `callback`, then decrements the lock.
- `DB_EnumXAssetEntries` follows `db_hashTable`, `g_assetEntryPool`, `entry.nextHash`, and `entry.nextOverride`; callback code must tolerate engine-owned asset lifetimes and lock scope.
- `DB_GetXAssetName` requires non-null `asset->header.data`, while `game_offset` requires a loaded `jb_mp_s.dll`; both conditions are enforced with `assert`.

## Dependencies

- `std_include.hpp` supplies Windows, STL, assertions, and timing facilities used by `HMODULE`, `GetModuleHandleA`, `InterlockedIncrement`, `std::function`, and `1ms`.
- `game/game.hpp` supplies `XAsset`, `XAssetType`, `XAssetEntryPoolEntry`, `dvar_s`, `Font_s`, `Material`, engine globals, and asset APIs.
- `component/engine/console/console.hpp` supplies `console::error` and `console::debug`.
- `utils/hook.hpp` is included for project hook integration, although no symbol from `utils::hook` is directly referenced here.

entries.response:
**memory.cpp allocates, duplicates, frees, tracks, and probes process memory.**

## Interface

- `memory::allocator::~allocator()` calls `clear()`.
- `memory::allocator::clear()` frees all `pool_` entries and empties the pool.
- `memory::allocator::allocate(const size_t)` returns zeroed `void*` tracked in `pool_`.
- `memory::allocator::duplicate_string(const std::string&)` returns tracked null-terminated `char*`.
- `memory::allocator::free(void*)`, `free(const void*)` release tracked pointers.
- `memory::allocator::empty() const` returns whether `pool_` is empty.
- `memory::allocate(const size_t)` uses `calloc(length, 1)` and asserts non-null.
- `memory::duplicate_string(const std::string&)` allocates `string.size() + 1` chars and copies bytes.
- `memory::free(void*)`, `free(const void*)` call `::free` when non-null.
- `memory::is_set(const void*, const char, const size_t)` tests whether all bytes equal `chr`.
- `memory::is_bad_read_ptr(const void*)` and `is_bad_code_ptr(const void*)` use Windows `VirtualQuery`.
- `memory::get_allocator()` returns `memory::allocator*` for static `memory::mem_allocator_`.

## Design and Contracts

`memory::allocator` uses `std::lock_guard`, `mutex_`, and `pool_` for synchronized ownership; `empty()` is not locked. `is_bad_read_ptr` accepts readable protections; `is_bad_code_ptr` accepts executable protections; both reject `PAGE_GUARD`, `PAGE_NOACCESS`, and failed `VirtualQuery`.

entries.response:
**string.cpp implements `utils::string` formatting, case conversion, matching, encoding, timestamp, hex-dump, and clipboard helpers.**

## Exports

- `va(const char* fmt, ...) -> const char*` formats variadic input through thread-local `va_provider<8, 256>`.
- `to_lower(std::string text) -> std::string` applies locale-dependent `std::tolower`.
- `to_upper(std::string text) -> std::string` applies locale-dependent `std::toupper`.
- `starts_with(const std::string& text, const std::string& substring) -> bool` checks prefix position zero.
- `ends_with(const std::string& text, const std::string& substring) -> bool` checks reverse suffix equality.
- `string_contains(const std::string_view& s1, std::string_view s2) -> bool` tests `std::string_view::find`.
- `convert(const std::string& str) -> std::wstring` widens each byte via `static_cast<wchar_t>`.
- `dump_hex(const std::string& data, const std::string& separator) -> std::string` emits uppercase `%02X` bytes joined by `separator`.
- `get_timestamp() -> std::string` emits `%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S` using `_localtime64_s`.
- `match_compare(const std::string& input, const std::string& text, bool exact) -> bool` selects equality or substring matching.
- `get_clipboard_data() -> std::string` reads Win32 clipboard format `1u`, returning `{}` on failure.

## Contracts

`va` uses `thread_local va_provider<8, 256>`; `dump_hex` masks bytes with `& 0xFF`; `get_timestamp` uses `MAX_PATH`; `get_clipboard_data` requires successful `OpenClipboard`, `GetClipboardData(1u)`, and `GlobalLock`.

**nt.hpp does Windows module loading, PE introspection, symbol resolution, invocation, and process control.**

## API

`utils::nt::library` wraps `HMODULE`; static `load(string)`, `load(path)`, `get_by_address(void*)`; constructors `library()`, `library(string)`, `library(HMODULE)`; equality, `operator bool()`, and `operator HMODULE()`.

`library` exposes `unprotect()`, `get_entry_point() -> void*`, `get_relative_entry_point() -> size_t`, `is_valid()`, `get_name()`, `get_path()`, `get_folder()`, `get_ptr() -> uint8_t*`, `get_handle() -> HMODULE`, `free()`, and `get_section_headers() -> vector<PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER>`.

`library` exposes PE accessors `get_nt_headers()`, `get_dos_header()`, `get_optional_header()`, plus `get_iat_entry(string module_name, string proc_name) -> void**`.

`library::get_proc<T>(string)`, `get<T>(string) -> function<T>`, `invoke<T, Args...>(string, Args...)`, `invoke_pascal<T, Args...>(string, Args...)`, and `invoke_this<T, Args...>(string, void*, Args...)` resolve exports using `GetProcAddress` and calling conventions; invalid lookups return default values.

`raise_hard_exception()`, `terminate(uint32_t code = 0)` are noreturn; `load_resource(int) -> string`, `relaunch_self()`, and `get_host_module() -> library` manage resources, relaunching, and the host module.

`library` depends on Windows PE types, `GetProcAddress`, `std::filesystem`, `std::function`, strings, vectors, and `std`; `invoke_this` passes `this_ptr` but its shown `get` call has an argument mismatch requiring verification.

entries.response:
**thread.cpp manages Windows thread naming, enumeration, suspension, and resumption.**

## Exports

`set_name(const HANDLE, const std::string&) -> bool`; `set_name(const DWORD, const std::string&) -> bool`; `set_name(std::thread&, const std::string&) -> bool`; `set_name(const std::string&) -> bool`; `get_thread_ids() -> std::vector<DWORD>`; `for_each_thread(const std::function<void(HANDLE)>&) -> void`; `suspend_other_threads() -> void`; `resume_other_threads() -> void`.

## Behavior

`set_name` dynamically resolves `SetThreadDescription` from `kernel32.dll`, converts via `string::convert`, and returns `SUCCEEDED`; thread-ID overloads acquire `THREAD_SET_LIMITED_INFORMATION`. `get_thread_ids` snapshots `TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD`, filters `GetCurrentProcessId()`, and validates `THREADENTRY32::dwSize`. `for_each_thread` opens matching threads with `THREAD_ALL_ACCESS`, invokes callbacks, and closes handles via `gsl::finally`. `suspend_other_threads` and `resume_other_threads` skip `GetCurrentThreadId()` and call `SuspendThread`/`ResumeThread`.

**game_console.cpp does hook-driven in-game console overlay rendering, input handling, command/dvar autocomplete, output buffering, history management, and version display for the `game_console` component.**

## Public Interface

- `bool is_active()` returns the process-global `overlay_active` state.
- `void append_output(std::string_view text)` queues console output under `get_pending_output_mutex()`, ignores empty text or `process_shutting_down`, and caps the pending queue at `max_console_lines * 2` entries.
- `void toggle()` invokes `toggle_overlay_state()` to open or close the overlay.
- `class component final : public component_interface` registers through `REGISTER_COMPONENT(game_console::component)`, initializes `console_state`, installs scheduler callbacks, and clears hooks during destruction.

## Runtime Integration

- `component::post_load()` allocates `con`, registers `con_outputHeightScale` through `dvars::Dvar_RegisterFloat("con_outputHeightScale", "Height scale for the shift-tab console output pane.", 0.72f, 0.20f, 0.98f, game::dvar_flags::saved)`, and schedules initialization on `scheduler::main`.
- `component::post_load()` schedules `install_hooks_if_ready()` every `50ms`, guarded output flushing, F1/OEM-key toggles, and `safe_process_console_input()` every `16ms`.
- `install_hooks_if_ready()` creates `cl_console_print_hook` against `game::CL_ConsolePrint.get()`, `cl_key_event_hook` against `game::CL_KeyEvent_.get()`, and `con_set_console_rect_hook` against `game::Con_SetConsoleRect.get()` once `get_window()` returns a valid `HWND`.
- `cl_console_print_stub(int local_client_num, int channel, const char* txt, int duration, int pixel_width, int flags)` mirrors `txt` into `append_console_text()` before forwarding all arguments through `cl_console_print_hook.invoke<void>()`.
- `con_set_console_rect_stub()` invokes the original `Con_SetConsoleRect` detour and then calls `draw_console_overlay()`.
- `cl_key_event_stub()` preserves the x86 register/stack ABI, calls `cl_key_event_body()`, swallows focused-game events when `should_swallow_key_event()` returns true, and otherwise forwards to `call_original_cl_key_event()`.
- `component::pre_destroy()` sets `process_shutting_down`, resets readiness flags, disables `overlay_active`, clears `cl_key_event_hook`, `cl_console_print_hook`, and `con_set_console_rect_hook`, then nulls `con`.
- `scheduler::on_shutdown()` resets `component_ready`, `hooks_installed`, `console_print_hook_installed`, `con_outputHeightScale`, keyboard state, and overlay state.

## State Model

- `console_state` stores `input`, `cursor`, `selection_start`, `selection_end`, `history_index`, history snapshot fields, `scroll_offset`, `output_visible`, `output_fullscreen`, `history`, `lines`, autocomplete matches/query/choice, query offsets, selected match index, and `may_auto_complete`.
- `overlay_active` controls visibility; `component_ready`, `hooks_installed`, `console_print_hook_installed`, and `process_shutting_down` gate lifecycle-sensitive operations.
- `key_was_down`, `key_is_down`, and `key_next_repeat_time` implement polling-based edge detection and repeat timing for 256 virtual-key slots.
- `get_pending_output_queue()` and `get_pending_output_mutex()` return leaked process-lifetime singletons, allowing output calls from outside the main rendering/input loop.
- `cached_command_names` and `cached_dvar_names` cache sanitized command and dvar identifiers; cache rebuilding traverses at most `4096` command nodes and `16384` nodes per each of `256` dvar hash buckets.

## Version and Prompt Contracts

- `build_display_version()` formats `VERSION_PRODUCT + "(" + VERSION_BUILD + ")" + ("-dbg-" or "-nightly-") + first-seven-character-GIT_HASH`, appending `"-dirty"` when `GIT_DIRTY` is true; `VERSION_BUILD` defaults to `"0"` when undefined.
- `build_prompt_version()` formats debug builds as `VERSION_PRODUCT + "-dbg"`, release builds as plain `VERSION_PRODUCT`, other builds as `VERSION_PRODUCT + "-nightly"`, followed by `" [" + short_hash + "]"` where dirty hashes use `"-dirty"`.
- `build_full_version_string()` formats `"Project: Consolation " + VERSION_PRODUCT + build_suffix + " build " + short_hash + dirty_suffix + " " + __DATE__ + " " + __TIME__ + " win-x86"`.
- `build_console_prompt()` returns `"Project: Consolation " + build_prompt_version() + " >"`.
- `draw_output_window()` displays `build_full_version_string()` as the footer, while `draw_input()` displays `build_console_prompt()` before `con->input`.

## Output Processing

- `append_console_text(const char* text)` removes carriage returns, splits on `'\n'`, and appends non-empty segments through `append_line()`.
- `append_line(const std::string& line)` suppresses consecutive duplicate lines and invokes `trim_console_lines()`.
- `trim_console_lines()` retains only the newest `max_console_lines == 128u` entries and clamps negative `con->scroll_offset` to zero.
- `flush_pending_output()` swaps the mutex-protected pending deque into a local deque, then feeds each queued string to `append_console_text()`.
- `strip_colors(std::string_view text)` removes `^` followed by an ASCII digit and removes `'\r'`.
- `strip_carriage_returns(std::string_view text)` removes every `'\r'`.
- `sanitize_display_text(std::string_view text)` applies `strip_colors()` and removes all bytes below ASCII `32` or above ASCII `126`.
- `try_copy_c_string(const char* text, std::string& out)` copies at most `511` bytes inside `__try/__except`, rejects null/empty input and access violations, and always terminates `buffer[511]`.
- `append_output()` queues raw text; `append_console_text()` performs line splitting; `sanitize_display_text()` is reserved for safe visible metadata/value rendering.

## Command and Dvar Discovery

- `to_lower(std::string value)` performs unsigned-character `std::tolower` conversion in place.
- `is_reasonable_console_token(std::string_view value)` accepts alphanumerics plus `_`, `-`, `+`, `.`, `:`, `/`, `\`, `*`, `?`, and `@`; all other characters reject the token.
- `safe_read_cmd_name(game::cmd_function_s* current, game::cmd_function_s** next_out, char* name, std::size_t name_size)` safely reads `current->next` and `current->name` with bounded copying and `__try/__except`.
- `safe_read_dvar_name(game::dvar_s* current, char* name, std::size_t name_size)` safely copies `current->name` with bounded copying and exception shielding.
- `safe_read_dvar_description(game::dvar_s* current, char* description, std::size_t description_size)` safely copies `current->description` with bounded copying and exception shielding.
- `safe_read_dvar_hash_entry(game::dvar_s* current, game::dvar_s** next_out, char* name, std::size_t name_size)` safely reads `current->hashNext` and `current->name`.
- `rebuild_auto_complete_cache()` deduplicates command and dvar names case-insensitively using `std::unordered_set<std::string>`, filters through `is_reasonable_console_token()`, and refreshes both global caches.
- `try_get_dvar_value_ptr(game::dvar_s* dvar, game::DvarValue value, const char** value_out)` calls `dvars::Dvar_ValueToString()` under `__try/__except` and rejects null converted values.
- `try_copy_dvar_domain(game::dvar_s* dvar, game::dvar_type& type_out, game::DvarLimits& domain_out)` safely copies `dvar->type` and `dvar->domain`.
- `is_dvar_command_token(std::string_view token)` recognizes exactly `set`, `seta`, `sets`, `reset`, `toggle`, and `togglep`, case-insensitively.
- `gather_auto_complete_matches(std::string input, bool exact)` ranks matches as exact, dvar-prefix, command-prefix, dvar-contained, and command-contained; each group sorts with `_stricmp`, and exact mode returns only case-insensitive equality matches.
- `gather_auto_complete_matches()` prioritizes dvars over commands within prefix and substring groups and deduplicates by lowercase identifier.
- `refresh_auto_complete()` strips one leading `/` or `\`, treats the first token as an exact command query when a space exists, treats the remainder as a dvar argument for `is_dvar_command_token()`, and retries after `rebuild_auto_complete_cache()` when no matches appear.
- `get_auto_complete_common_prefix()` computes the case-insensitive longest common prefix across `con->auto_complete_matches`.
- `sync_auto_complete_choice()` wraps `auto_complete_selected_index` modulo match count and updates `auto_complete_choice`.
- `cycle_auto_complete_choice(int direction)` wraps selection across all matches, supporting forward and backward cycling.
- `commit_auto_complete_choice(bool append_space)` replaces the tracked query with `auto_complete_choice` through `apply_auto_complete_text()`.
- `apply_auto_complete_text(std::string text, bool append_space)` replaces the query range, advances `con->cursor`, optionally inserts one space while `cursor < max_input_chars`, clears selection, and refreshes autocomplete.
- `handle_auto_complete()` commits a single match with a trailing space, inserts a longer common prefix without a space, or cycles among multiple matches.

## Input Editing and Clipboard

- `set_overlay_active(bool active)` resets keyboard state and autocomplete; opening resets history/output navigation, while closing clears input and cursor state.
- `clear_auto_complete()` clears all autocomplete fields and sets `may_auto_complete` false.
- `clear_input_line()` empties `con->input`, moves the cursor to zero, and clears autocomplete.
- `set_cursor_position(std::size_t cursor)` clamps the cursor to `con->input.size()` and clears selection.
- `select_entire_input()` selects `[0, input.size()]` and moves the cursor to the end.
- `delete_input_selection()` erases the normalized selection range, moves the cursor to its beginning, and invalidates the history snapshot.
- `insert_character(char ch)` replaces any selection, enforces `max_input_chars == 240u`, inserts at the cursor, invalidates the snapshot, and refreshes autocomplete.
- `insert_text(std::string text)` removes `'\r'`, `'\n'`, and `'\t'`, truncates to the remaining `max_input_chars == 240u` capacity, inserts at the cursor, and refreshes autocomplete.
- `insert_wide_text(const WCHAR* text, int length)` converts each UTF-16 code unit through `WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, ...)` and accepts printable bytes `>= 32` excluding `127`.
- `paste_from_clipboard()` reads `CF_TEXT` through `OpenClipboard()`, `GetClipboardData()`, and `GlobalLock()`, then delegates insertion to `insert_text()`.
- `copy_text_to_clipboard(std::string_view text)` writes a null-terminated `CF_TEXT` global allocation through `EmptyClipboard()` and `SetClipboardData()`.
- `handle_ctrl_shortcut(int vk)` maps Ctrl+A to select all, Ctrl+Shift+C to copy, Ctrl+V to paste, and Ctrl+L to clear output; Ctrl+C without Shift is passed through as non-handled.
- `clear_dead_key_state()` calls `ToUnicode(VK_SPACE, MapVirtualKeyA(VK_SPACE, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC), ...)` with a zeroed keyboard state to consume dead-key state.
- `handle_text_key(int vk)` obtains `GetKeyboardState()`, translates through `MapVirtualKeyA()` and `ToUnicode()`, inserts translated text, and clears dead-key state for negative `ToUnicode()` results.

## History and Command Execution

- `trim_history()` retains at most `max_history_entries == 32u` newest commands.
- `save_history_snapshot()` stores input, cursor, and selection only when `history_snapshot_valid` is false.
- `restore_history_snapshot()` restores clamped snapshot fields, normalizes empty selection to the cursor, clears validity, and refreshes autocomplete.
- `history_up()` saves the editable snapshot on first navigation, moves toward older entries, loads the selected history command, and refreshes autocomplete.
- `history_down()` moves toward newer entries, restores the snapshot after the newest entry, or clears input when no snapshot exists.
- `execute_input()` optionally commits autocomplete, appends `"] " + con->input` to visible output, deduplicates adjacent history entries, trims history, sends `con->input + "\n"` through `game::Cbuf_AddText(0, command.c_str())`, then clears input/navigation/autocomplete state.
- `handle_special_key(int vk)` maps `VK_ESCAPE` to close, `VK_RETURN` to execute, `VK_BACK`/`VK_DELETE` to deletion, arrows/Home/End to cursor/history/navigation, `VK_PRIOR`/`VK_NEXT` to six-line scrolling, and `VK_TAB` to autocomplete or Shift/Ctrl output-pane toggles.
- `scroll_output(int amount)` changes `con->scroll_offset` only when output is visible; autocomplete match view reverses the sign relative to normal output scrolling.
- `handle_full_console_toggle_press()` opens the overlay if necessary and toggles `output_visible` plus `output_fullscreen`; the full-console view is reached through Shift+OEM key.
- `toggle_overlay_state()` delegates state transitions to `set_overlay_active()`.

## Keyboard and Focus Contracts

- `get_window()` returns `*game::main_window`.
- `is_game_focused()` requires a valid window and `GetForegroundWindow() == hwnd`.
- `is_key_down(int vk)` tests `(GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0`.
- `is_modifier_down(int vk, int left_vk, int right_vk)` combines polled aggregate, left/right cached, and left/right OS key states.
- `is_any_shift_down()` checks `VK_SHIFT`, `VK_LSHIFT`, and `VK_RSHIFT`; `is_any_ctrl_down()` checks `VK_CONTROL`, `VK_LCONTROL`, and `VK_RCONTROL`.
- `process_console_input()` polls virtual keys `8..255`, recognizes first presses and repeatable-key repeats, uses a `350u` initial repeat delay and `45u` repeat interval, and excludes F1, `VK_OEM_5`, and `VK_OEM_102` from text insertion.
- `safe_process_console_input()` requires `component_ready`, `overlay_active`, a valid focused `HWND`, and non-shutdown state, then catches all structured exceptions around `process_console_input()`.
- `cl_key_event_body(int local_client_num, int key, int down, unsigned int time)` handles mouse-wheel scrolling on key-down and returns `1` when focused overlay input should be swallowed.
- F1 toggles `overlay_active`; OEM-5 and OEM-102 toggle normally, while Shift+OEM-5 or Shift+OEM-102 toggles the full output console.
- `debug_log_toggle(const char* key_name)` is compiled as a no-op in release and retains a disabled debug logging block under `DEBUG`.

## Rendering

- `get_console_font()` returns `*game::con_font` when available, otherwise registers `"fonts/normalFont"` through `game::R_RegisterFont()`.
- `get_white_material()` registers the `"white"` material through `game::Material_RegisterHandle()`.
- `resolve_layout_width(const game::ScreenPlacement& scr_place)` prefers the larger positive real viewport dimension, then virtual viewable dimension, then `640.0f`.
- `resolve_layout_height(const game::ScreenPlacement& scr_place)` prefers the smaller positive real viewport dimension, then virtual viewable dimension, then `480.0f`.
- `get_overlay_bounds()` uses the client rectangle when available, otherwise `game::ScrPlace_GetViewPlacement()`, with six-pixel screen margins, minimum bounds `634.0f × 474.0f`, and font-derived visible line/width calculations.
- `draw_box(float x, float y, float width, float height, float* color)` draws a filled rectangle and two-pixel darkened borders through `game::R_AddCmdDrawStretchPic()`.
- `draw_text(const char* text, float x, float y, float* color, float scale)` draws text through `game::R_AddCmdDrawText()` with `0x7FFFFFFF` character limit.
- `draw_text_shadowed()` draws `overlay_shadow_color` at `+1.0f,+1.0f` before the requested text.
- `draw_input_box()` and `draw_hint_box()` construct bordered panels from `draw_box()`.
- `draw_hint_text()` positions lines using `font_height`, line index, `15.0f` vertical padding, and optional offsets.
- `draw_dvar_match_details()` safely renders current, latched, default, description, and domain data; unavailable values use `"<unavailable>"`, and latched dvars are detected with `game::dvar_flags::latched`.
- `draw_input()` renders the prompt, selection highlight, input text, blinking `|` caret, and autocomplete; the caret blink period is `500ms`.
- `draw_input()` displays `"%i matches (too many to show here, press shift+tilde to open full console)"` when matches exceed `max_auto_complete_matches == 24u`.
- `draw_output_scrollbar()` scales the slider by `visible_lines / total_lines` and positions it using `con->scroll_offset`.
- `draw_output_window()` uses `con_outputHeightScale` clamped to `[0.20f, 0.98f]` with fallback `0.72f` for non-fullscreen output, while fullscreen output uses scale `1.0f`.
- `draw_console_overlay()` renders only when `is_active()`, `con`, valid bounds, and non-shutdown state exist; it draws output before input when `con->output_visible` is true.

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- `loader/component_loader.hpp` supplies `component_interface` and `REGISTER_COMPONENT`.
- `component/utils/scheduler.hpp` supplies `scheduler::main`, `scheduler::once`, `scheduler::loop`, and `scheduler::on_shutdown`.
- `game/game.hpp` supplies engine globals/functions including `CL_ConsolePrint`, `CL_KeyEvent_`, `Con_SetConsoleRect`, `Cbuf_AddText`, `main_window`, `con_font`, `R_RegisterFont`, `Material_RegisterHandle`, `R_AddCmdDrawStretchPic`, `R_AddCmdDrawText`, `R_TextWidth`, `ScrPlace_GetViewPlacement`, `cmd_functions`, `dvarHashTable`, and `Dvar_FindVar`.
- `game/dvars.hpp` supplies `dvars::Dvar_RegisterFloat`, `dvars::Dvar_ValueToString`, and `dvars::dvar_get_domain`.
- `utils::hook::detour` requires original-function invocation and explicit `clear()` during teardown.
- Windows APIs (`HWND`, `RECT`, `GetAsyncKeyState`, `GetForegroundWindow`, `GetClientRect`, clipboard APIs, `ToUnicode`, `WideCharToMultiByte`, `GlobalAlloc`, and structured exception handling) make the implementation Windows/x86-specific.
- `GIT_HASH`, `GIT_DIRTY`, `VERSION_PRODUCT`, `VERSION_BUILD`, `DEBUG`, and `NDEBUG` control observable version text.

```markdown
# Local XLive storage

The offline shim stores emulated Games for Windows - LIVE state beside the game
executable:

```text
storage/
  profiles/
    <16-digit XUID>/
      settings/
        41560829/
          63E83FFD.bin
          63E83FFE.bin
          63E83FFF.bin
      title_storage/
        <facility>/
          <item name>
```

`41560829` is the Quantum of Solace PC title ID. The three `63E83FFD` through
`63E83FFF` files are the raw payloads of the SDK's title-specific binary profile
settings. Files under `title_storage` are the payloads handled by
`XStorageUploadFromMemory` and `XStorageDownloadToMemory`, such as `mpdata`.

On the first profile-settings read, the shim searches
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Xlive\Content` for `41560829.gpd`. It validates the
little-endian `FBDX`/XDBF tables and imports namespace 3 binary-setting payloads
that do not already exist locally. Account data, signatures, achievements, and
other games are deliberately not copied.

The directory XUID is generated deterministically from the active `name` dvar,
with command-line `name`/`-set name` as the early-startup fallback. Changing the
name therefore selects a different offline profile.

```

entries.response:
**nt.cpp does Windows DLL/PE module loading, inspection, import lookup, resource access, relaunch, and process-control operations.**

## Public interface

`library::load(const std::string& name)` calls `LoadLibraryA`; `library::load(const std::filesystem::path& path)` converts `path` via `generic_string()` and delegates.

`library::get_by_address(void* address)` resolves the containing module with `GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT`.

`library::library()`, `library::library(const std::string& name)`, and `library::library(const HMODULE handle)` construct wrappers around the current process module, `GetModuleHandleA(name.data())`, or an existing `HMODULE`.

`library::operator==(const library&) const`, `library::operator bool() const`, and `library::operator HMODULE() const` compare handles, validate modules, and expose `HMODULE` conversion.

`library::get_nt_headers() const` returns `PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS`; `library::get_dos_header() const` returns `PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER`; `library::get_optional_header() const` returns `PIMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER`.

`library::get_section_headers() const` returns `std::vector<PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER>` from `IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt_headers)` and `NumberOfSections`.

`library::get_ptr() const` returns the module base as `std::uint8_t*`; `library::get_handle() const` returns `HMODULE`.

`library::unprotect() const` applies `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` to `SizeOfImage` using `VirtualProtect`.

`library::get_relative_entry_point() const` returns `AddressOfEntryPoint` as `size_t`; `library::get_entry_point() const` returns the base plus that RVA as `void*`.

`library::is_valid() const` checks non-null `module_` and `IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE`; `library::get_name() const`, `library::get_path() const`, and `library::get_folder() const` return basename, `GetModuleFileNameA` path, and parent directory.

`library::free()` calls `FreeLibrary` for valid handles and clears `module_`.

`library::get_iat_entry(const std::string& module_name, const std::string& proc_name) const` returns `void**` for a matching Import Address Table slot, resolving `other_module.get_proc<void*>(proc_name)` and supporting ordinal imports through `IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL`.

`raise_hard_exception()` adjusts privilege 19 and invokes `ntdll.dll` functions `RtlAdjustPrivilege` and `NtRaiseHardError` with status `0xC000007B`.

`load_resource(const int id)` returns `RT_RCDATA` bytes as `std::string`; `relaunch_self()` starts the current executable with `CreateProcessA`; `terminate(const uint32_t code)` calls `TerminateProcess`; `get_host_module()` returns a static `utils::nt::library`.

## Integration and contracts

`std_include.hpp` supplies Windows APIs/types; `nt.hpp` declares `library`, `get_proc`, and `invoke_pascal`; `utils/string.hpp` is included but has no visible direct use.

`library::get_path()` uses `char name[MAX_PATH]`; `relaunch_self()` uses `STARTUPINFOA`, `PROCESS_INFORMATION`, `GetCurrentDirectoryA(MAX_PATH)`, and the existing `GetCommandLineA()`.

`library::get_iat_entry()` compares module/function names case-insensitively with `_stricmp`, scans `IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT`, and returns `nullptr` on invalid modules, missing imports, absent targets, or unmatched entries.

`library::get_section_headers()` emits `OutputDebugStringA("pushing back section woooo\n")` and `OutputDebugStringA("There was an invalid section :O\n")`; callers must avoid invalid `library` instances because it dereferences PE headers without an initial validity guard.

`library::free()` assumes ownership appropriate for `LoadLibraryA` handles; `get_by_address()` explicitly requests `GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT`, so its result should not be freed.

entries.response:
**resource.rc embeds Windows DLL metadata and Visual C++ TEXTINCLUDE resources for Consolation.**

## Interface

`resource.rc` exports no functions, classes, types, or constants; resource identifiers `1`, `2`, and `VS_VERSION_INFO` define the consumable interface.

## Build Integration

`APSTUDIO_READONLY_SYMBOLS` brackets generated sections; `#include "windows.h"`, `#include "version.h"`, and `#include "resource.hpp"` supply Win32, version, and project resource definitions. `#pragma code_page(65001)` selects UTF-8 source encoding, while generated content is guarded by `APSTUDIO_INVOKED`.

`TEXTINCLUDE` resource `1` emits `"#include ""windows.h""\r\n"`; `TEXTINCLUDE` resource `2` emits `"\r\n"`; `TEXTINCLUDE` resource `3` is reserved and contains no payload.

## Version Resource

`VS_VERSION_INFO VERSIONINFO` defines a DLL with `FILEOS 0x40004L`, `FILETYPE VFT_DLL`, and `FILESUBTYPE 0x0L`; `FILEVERSION VERSION_FILE_RC` and `PRODUCTVERSION VERSION_PRODUCT_RC` defer numeric versions to macros.

`FILEFLAGS 0x3fL` is the mask; `_DEBUG` selects `VS_FF_DEBUG`, otherwise `PRERELEASE` selects `VS_FF_PRERELEASE`, non-`CI` builds select `VS_FF_PRIVATEBUILD`, and `CI` builds select `0x0L`.

`StringFileInfo` block `"040904b0"` defines `CompanyName="Consolation"`, `FileDescription="Consolation"`, `FileVersion=VERSION_FILE`, `InternalName="Consolation"`, `LegalCopyright="Copyright © 2024 Consolation. All rights reserved."`, `Licence="GPLv3"`, `Info=""`, `OriginalFilename="d3d9.dll"`, `ProductName="Consolation"`, and `ProductVersion=VERSION_PRODUCT`.

`VarFileInfo` sets `Translation` to `0x409, 1200`, representing English (United States) and Unicode code page 1200.

## Conditional Behavior

`AFx_RESOURCE_DLL` and `AFX_TARG_ENU` suppress the English resource block when either macro is defined; `APSTUDIO_INVOKED` controls generated editor-only resources, and `CI` changes release metadata flags.

**src\sdllp.cpp proxies selected d3d9.dll exports to the system library with multiplayer-aware passthrough logic.**

## Interface

- `sdllp::load_library(const char* library)` loads `%SystemRoot%\System32\<library>` via `LoadLibraryA`, caches it in `sdllp::libraries`.
- `sdllp::is_loaded(const char* library) -> bool` checks cached `HINSTANCE` validity.
- `sdllp::get_export(const char* function, const char* library) -> FARPROC` lazy-loads `library`, resolves `function` with `GetProcAddress`, and reports failures via `MessageBoxA`.
- `sdllp::libraries` is the static `std::map<std::string, HINSTANCE>` cache.
- `D3DPERF_BeginEvent()`, `D3DPERF_EndEvent()`, and `Direct3DCreate9()` are `extern "C" __declspec(naked) __declspec(dllexport) void` trampolines generated by `EXPORT`; each jumps to its lazily resolved system-library address.

## Proxy Policy

- `should_load_proxy_library("d3d9.dll")` returns `is_multiplayer_host()`; all other libraries return `true`.
- `is_multiplayer_host()` recognizes hosts `JB_Launcher_s.exe`, `JB_LiveEngine_s.exe`, loaded `jb_mp_s.dll`, or the `multiplayer` flag.
- `singleplayer_warning_shown` gates one `d3d9.dll` warning: `"Project: Consolation does not support singleplayer.\n\nLaunching without modifications using the default system d3d9.dll."`
- `utils::nt::get_host_module`, `utils::flags::has_flag`, and `utils::string::va` supply host detection, CLI flags, and formatted diagnostics; Win32 APIs supply loading, resolution, module detection, and message boxes.

## Build Constraint

- `#pragma warning(disable: 4740)` permits inline assembly in naked `EXPORT` trampolines; `LIBRARY` is the exact target `"d3d9.dll"`.

entries.response:
**config.yaml configures agents-reverse-engineer discovery, summarization, AI execution, and telemetry behavior.**

## Configuration Schema

- `exclude.patterns: string[]` excludes documentation, secrets, locks, logs, tests, specs, CI/editor configs, infrastructure, dependencies, and temporary files.
- `exclude.vendorDirs: string[]` skips `node_modules`, `vendor`, `deps`, `.git`, `dist`, `build`, `__pycache__`, `.next`, `venv`, `.venv`, `target`, `.cargo`, `.gradle`, `.agents-reverse-engineer`, `.agents`, `.planning`, `.claude`, `.codex`, `.opencode`, and `.gemini`.
- `exclude.binaryExtensions: string[]` skips `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.bmp`, `.ico`, `.webp`, `.zip`, `.tar`, `.gz`, `.rar`, `.7z`, `.exe`, `.dll`, `.so`, `.dylib`, `.mp3`, `.mp4`, `.wav`, `.pdf`, `.woff`, `.woff2`, `.ttf`, `.eot`, `.class`, and `.pyc`.
- `options.followSymlinks: boolean` defaults to `false`; `options.maxFileSize: number` defaults to `1048576` bytes.
- `output.colors: boolean` defaults to `true`.
- `generation.compressionRatio: number` is `0.25`, targeting summaries near 25% of source size; valid documented range is `0.1–1.0`, while annex handling bypasses compression for reproduction-critical content.

## AI Runtime

- `ai.backend: string` selects `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `opencode`, or `auto`; current value is `codex`.
- `ai.model: string` selects the backend-specific model; current value is `gpt-5.6-luna`.
- `ai.upgradeModel` is unset; `are specify` and `are rebuild` therefore retain `ai.model`.
- `ai.timeoutMs: number` sets subprocess timeout to `300000` ms.
- `ai.maxRetries: number` allows `3` retries for transient errors.
- `ai.concurrency` is unset, so runtime auto-detection applies; documented range is `1–20`, with current machine default `20`.
- `ai.telemetry.keepRuns: number` retains the latest `50` run logs under `.agents-reverse-engineer/logs/`.

## Exclusion Contracts

`exclude.patterns` contains exact glob rules including `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.override.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `OPENCODE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `"**/AGENTS.md"`, `"**/AGENTS.override.md"`, `"**/CLAUDE.md"`, `"**/OPENCODE.md"`, `"**/GEMINI.md"`, `"*.local.md"`, `"**/*.local.md"`, `"AGENTS.*.md"`, `"**/AGENTS.*.md"`, `"*.lock"`, lockfile names, `".env"`, `"**/.env"`, `"**/.env.*"`, `"*.log"`, `"**/*.sum"`, `"**/SKILL.md"`, test/spec globs, automation/config globs, infrastructure globs, `"deps/**"`, `"_tmp_iw4x_gamepad/**"`, `".github/**"`, `".vscode/**"`; these rules define observable traversal scope.

entries.response:
**src/main.cpp does Windows DLL startup validation, DPI setup, component-loader initialization, and fatal-error handling for Project: Consolation.**

## Interface

- `int WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE module, DWORD reason, LPVOID)` disables thread notifications on `DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH`, invokes `main()`, and returns `FALSE` when startup fails.
- `main() -> bool` enables DPI awareness, seeds `rand`, validates installation, runs `component_loader::post_start()` and `component_loader::post_load()`, and converts startup exceptions into message boxes plus `component_loader::pre_destroy()`.

## Installation Validation

- `local_offline_mode_requested() -> bool` accepts flags `offline`, `local_offline`, and `local-offline`.
- `has_system_xlive() -> bool` checks `%SystemDirectory%\\xlive.dll` via `GetSystemDirectoryA`, `GetFileAttributesA`, `MAX_PATH`, and `FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY`.
- `validate_supported_install() -> void` requires system Games for Windows - LIVE unless local offline mode is requested, logs the `jb_mp_s.dll` marker, and rejects unsupported installs.
- `has_supported_multiplayer_marker(const std::filesystem::path& game_root) -> bool` reads `jb_mp_s.dll` RVA `0x0050502C` through `utils::io::read_pe_string_rva` and requires case-insensitive equality with `"multiplayer"`.
- `read_multiplayer_marker_for_log(const std::filesystem::path& game_root) -> std::string` returns the same PE marker or sentinel `"<missing>"`.
- `show_missing_gfwl_and_exit() -> noreturn` displays a Yes/No error dialog, optionally opens `gfwl_update_url`, then calls `utils::nt::terminate(1)`.
- `show_unsupported_version_and_exit() -> noreturn` displays a version error dialog, optionally opens `unsupported_update_url`, then calls `utils::nt::terminate(1)`.

`gfwl_update_url` is `https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/1012-microsoft-games-for-windows-live/`; `unsupported_update_url` is `https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/1089-007-quantum-of-solace-patch/`; `multiplayer_marker_rva` is `std::uint32_t(0x0050502C)`.

## Runtime Initialization

- `enable_dpi_awareness() -> void` applies a compatibility fallback chain: `SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2)`, `SetProcessDpiAwareness(PROCESS_PER_MONITOR_DPI_AWARE)`, then `SetProcessDPIAware`, dynamically resolved from `user32.dll` and `shcore.dll` via `utils::nt::library`.
- `exit_hook(int code) -> noreturn` calls `component_loader::pre_destroy()` before `exit(code)`.
- `unprotect_module(HMODULE module) -> void` parses PE headers and changes `SizeOfImage` protection to `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` with `VirtualProtect`; it is currently unused.
- `original_code[5]` and `original_ep` (`PBYTE`, initialized `nullptr`) are reserved hook state and currently unused.
- `configure_debug_crt() -> void` (under `DEBUG`) routes CRT warning, error, and assertion reports to the debugger through `_CrtSetReportMode`; `xlive::apply_early()` remains intentionally disabled.

## Coupling and Failure Semantics

- `main()` depends on `utils::flags`, `utils::io`, `utils::nt`, Win32 Shell/DPI APIs, and `component_loader`; `component_loader::post_start()` and `component_loader::post_load()` failures are thrown as `"post start failed"` and `"post load failed"`.
- `main()` catches `std::exception`, `const char*`, `std::string`, and unknown exceptions, always invoking `component_loader::pre_destroy()` before showing an `"ERROR"` dialog and returning `false`.
- `DllMain` performs substantial initialization during process attach; `DisableThreadLibraryCalls` limits callback overhead, while `utils::nt::terminate(1)` handles non-recoverable validation failures.

**generate.bat generates the VS2022 solution after synchronizing submodules and selecting a verified Premake executable.**

## Interface

- `PREMAKE_URL` pins Premake `v5.0.0-beta8` Windows ZIP; `PREMAKE_HASH` pins SHA-256 `2301e3e23ff3074cb83a5ea6103d68c7ea81dad56b786807c84b0643cddea31b`.
- `PREMAKE_NO_GLOBAL` skips PATH lookup; `PREMAKE_NO_PROMPT` enables automatic download without confirmation.
- `:downloadpremake()` creates `tools`, downloads `PREMAKE_URL`, extracts `tools\premake5.exe`, verifies `PREMAKE_HASH`, and returns `0` or `2`.
- `:verifypremake(path)` computes SHA-256 through PowerShell and returns `0` for `PREMAKE_HASH` equality or `1` otherwise.
- `:runpremake()` executes `%PREMAKE_BIN% %* vs2022`, creates `build`, and returns `1` on generation failure.

## Workflow and contracts

- `git submodule sync --recursive` and `git submodule update --init --recursive` abort with exit code `1` on failure.
- `deps\SDL\include\SDL.h` takes precedence over fallback `deps\SDL2-src\SDL2-2.32.10\include\SDL.h`; missing SDL emits a warning and prevents SDL backend generation.
- `PREMAKE_BIN` selection prefers global `premake5.exe`, then hash-verified `tools\premake5.exe`, then download; existing mismatched binaries are rejected.
- `POWERSHELL_BIN` prefers `pwsh`, otherwise `powershell`; `Invoke-WebRequest` and `Expand-Archive` run with `-NoProfile -NonInteractive`.
- `%*` preserves all caller arguments before the mandatory `vs2022` action; successful output targets `build\consolation-client.sln`.

**README.md documents Consolation’s supported game version, installation/launch workflow, nightly-build policy, credits, and project context.**

## Project Scope

Consolation targets the multiplayer PC port of *007: Quantum of Solace*, an IW3/T4-adjacent Call of Duty-engine game; English/French `1.1` is the only confirmed supported release.

## Public Interface

README.md exports no code symbols, functions, classes, types, or constants.

- Obtain the game from MyAbandonware; install to `C:\Program Files (x86)\Activision\Quantum of Solace(TM)\`.

Nightly builds are automatically published under GitHub Releases, experimental, potentially unstable or broken, intended strictly for testing, and receive no support.

Installation, controller support, and crash debugging are delegated to the linked GitHub wiki pages; credits identify contributors to zones/zonetool, GSC support/injection, patches, IW3 research, raw mouse input, controller/DualSense support, and related IW3 projects.

**dvars.cpp registers, describes, overrides, replaces, and lifecycle-manages game console variables (dvars).**

## Role and integration

`dvars::component` implements `component_interface::post_load()` and is registered through `REGISTER_COMPONENT(dvars::component)`. `component::post_load()` installs override metadata, schedules main-thread registration, refreshes selected UI dvars every `250ms`, and nulls managed pointers during shutdown.

`game::Dvar_RegisterNew`, `game::Dvar_FindVar`, `game::DvarType`, `game::DvarValue`, `game::DvarLimits`, `game::dvar_s`, and `game::dvar_flags` define the engine-facing dvar ABI. `console::debug` logs registration and override operations; `scheduler::once`, `scheduler::loop`, `scheduler::on_shutdown`, and `scheduler::main` control lifecycle and thread affinity. `utils::string::va` formats domain and value strings; `utils::hook::nop` removes original registration instructions.

## Public state

`dvar_map` is an `std::unordered_map<std::int32_t, dvar_info>` for indexed dvar metadata.

The following `game::dvar_s*` globals cache engine dvar addresses and are initialized to `nullptr`: `con_inputBoxColor`, `con_inputHintBoxColor`, `con_outputBarColor`, `con_outputSliderColor`, `con_outputWindowColor`, `con_inputDvarMatchColor`, `con_inputDvarValueColor`, `con_inputDvarInactiveValueColor`, `con_inputCmdMatchColor`, `g_debugVelocity`, `g_debugLocalization`, `r_borderless`, `bot_maxHealth`, `m_rawInput`, `gpad_enabled`, `gpad_present`, `gpad_in_use`, `gpad_debug`, `gpad_buttonsConfig`, `gpad_sticksConfig`, `gpad_rumble`, `gpad_stick_deadzone_min`, `gpad_stick_deadzone_max`, `gpad_button_deadzone`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_first`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_rest`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_min`, `gpad_menu_scroll_accel_time`, `input_invertPitch`, `cg_drawWatermark`, `cg_drawVersion`, `cg_drawVersionX`, `cg_drawVersionY`, `r_aspectRatioCustomEnable`, `r_aspectRatioCustom`, and `r_ultrawideCustomMode`.

## Domain and value formatting

`dvar_get_vector_domain(int components, const game::DvarLimits& domain) -> std::string` formats vector ranges using `domain.vector.min` and `domain.vector.max`; `-FLT_MAX` and `FLT_MAX` mean unbounded, yielding exact templates `Domain is any %iD vector`, `Domain is any %iD vector with components %g or smaller`, `Domain is any %iD vector with components %g or bigger`, or `Domain is any %iD vector with components from %g to %g`.

`dvar_get_domain(game::dvar_type type, const game::DvarLimits& domain) -> std::string` maps boolean, scalar, vector, integer, color, enumeration, and string domains to user-facing descriptions: `Domain is 0 or 1`, `Domain is any number`, `Domain is any number %g or smaller`, `Domain is any number %g or bigger`, `Domain is any number from %g to %g`, `Domain is any integer`, `Domain is any integer %i or smaller`, `Domain is any integer %i or bigger`, `Domain is any integer from %i to %i`, `Domain is any 4-component color, in RGBA format`, `Domain is any text`, or `unhandled dvar type '%i'`.

`dvar_get_domain()` treats `domain.enumeration.stringCount` as the unbounded-integer sentinel when it equals `INT_MIN`; enumeration output starts with `Domain is one of the following:` and appends `\n  %2i: %s` per entry.

`dvar_type_name(game::DvarType type) -> const char*` returns `bool`, `int`, `float`, or `string` for `DVAR_TYPE_BOOL`, `DVAR_TYPE_INT`, `DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT`, and `DVAR_TYPE_STRING`; all other types return `dvar`.

`dvar_value_to_string(const dvar_spec& spec) -> std::string` serializes booleans as `true`/`false`, integers with `%d`, floats with `%g`, strings as `"\"%s\""`, and unsupported types as `<?>`; null string values serialize as an empty string.

## Override registration API

`overrides::register_bool_overrides`, `overrides::register_int_overrides`, `overrides::register_float_overrides`, `overrides::register_enum_overrides`, and `overrides::register_string_overrides` store named override records in `std::unordered_map<std::string, ...>` containers.

`overrides::register_bool(const std::string& name, bool value, unsigned int flags) -> void` stores `dvar_bool{value, flags}` in `register_bool_overrides`.

`overrides::register_int(const std::string& name, int value, int min, int max, unsigned int flags) -> void` stores value, bounds, and flags in `register_int_overrides`.

`overrides::register_float(const std::string& name, float value, float min, float max, unsigned int flags) -> void` stores value, bounds, and flags in `register_float_overrides`.

`overrides::register_enum(const std::string& name, const char* const* value_list, int default_index, unsigned int flags) -> void` stores the enum list, default index, and flags in `register_enum_overrides`.

`overrides::register_string(const std::string& name, const std::string& value, unsigned int flags) -> void` stores the default string and flags in `register_string_overrides`.

## Engine registration wrappers

`Dvar_RegisterFloat(const char* dvar_name, const char* description, double float_value, double min_value, double max_value, std::uint16_t flags) -> game::dvar_s*` builds `DvarValue::value`, `DvarLimits::value`, logs `registered dvar '%s'\n`, and calls `game::Dvar_RegisterNew(..., game::DvarType::DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT, ...)`.

`Dvar_RegisterVec4(const char* dvar_name, const char* description, float x, float y, float z, float w, float min_value, float max_value, std::uint16_t flags) -> game::dvar_s*` fills `DvarValue::vector[0..3]`, sets `DvarLimits::vector`, and registers `DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT_4`.

`Dvar_RegisterBool(const char* dvar_name, int value_default, const char* description, std::uint16_t flags) -> game::dvar_s*` maps `value_default` to `DvarValue::enabled`, constrains `DvarLimits::integer` to `[0, 1]`, and registers `DVAR_TYPE_BOOL`.

`Dvar_RegisterInt(const char* dvar_name, const char* description, int value_default, int min, int max, std::uint16_t flags) -> game::dvar_s*` fills integer value and bounds, then registers `DVAR_TYPE_INT`.

`Dvar_RegisterString(const char* dvar_name, const char* value_default, const char* description, std::uint16_t flags) -> game::dvar_s*` fills `DvarValue::string`, leaves limits default-initialized, and registers `DVAR_TYPE_STRING`.

`Dvar_ValueToString(game::dvar_s* dvar, game::DvarValue value) -> char*` invokes the game executable at `game::game_offset(0x10274F80)` through inline x86 assembly, passing `value` on the stack and `dvar` in `ecx`; the returned engine-owned `char*` must be treated according to engine lifetime rules.

## Specification builders and registration

`register_dvar(const dvar_spec& spec, bool log) -> game::dvar_s*` dispatches on `spec.type`, optionally logs `overriding %s dvar '%s' with %s\n`, and delegates to the typed wrappers; unsupported types return `nullptr`.

`make_bool(const char* name, const char* description, bool value, std::uint16_t flags) -> dvar_spec` creates `DVAR_TYPE_BOOL`, stores `value.enabled`, and assigns integer domain `[0, 1]`.

`make_int(const char* name, const char* description, int value, int min, int max, std::uint16_t flags) -> dvar_spec` creates `DVAR_TYPE_INT`, stores `value.integer`, and assigns integer domain `[min, max]`.

`make_float(const char* name, const char* description, float value, float min, float max, std::uint16_t flags) -> dvar_spec` creates `DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT`, stores `value.value`, and assigns scalar domain `[min, max]`.

`make_string(const char* name, const char* description, const char* value, std::uint16_t flags) -> dvar_spec` creates `DVAR_TYPE_STRING`, stores `value.string`, and leaves its domain default-initialized.

`replace_dvar(const dvar_spec& spec, bool log) -> game::dvar_s*` finds `spec.name`; existing dvars receive the new value in `current`, `latched`, and `reset`, receive `spec.domain`, set `modified = true`, and retain only writable existing flags plus `spec.flags`. Missing dvars are created through the typed registration wrappers, with optional `registered %s dvar '%s' = %s\n` logging.

`replace_dvar_at(std::uintptr_t nop_address, std::size_t nop_size, game::dvar_s** target, const dvar_spec& spec, bool log) -> game::dvar_s*` calls `utils::hook::nop(nop_address, nop_size)`, reuses an existing dvar while preserving its value, updates domain and writable flags, optionally writes the result through `target`, or registers a new dvar via `register_dvar`.

`set_saved_dvar_flags(game::dvar_s* dvar, std::uint16_t desired_flags)` is private and ignores null pointers; it removes existing `read_only`, `write_protected`, and `latched` bits, then ORs `desired_flags` into the remaining `std::uint16_t` flags.

## Runtime dvar set

`component::post_load()` registers the override `monkeytoy = false` with `game::dvar_flags::none`.

The `scheduler::once` callback on `scheduler::main` initializes `r_borderless` by reusing `game::Dvar_FindVar("r_borderless")` or registering saved `r_borderless` with default `0` and description `Do not use a border in windowed mode`.

The `scheduler::once` callback registers `g_debugVelocity`, `g_debugLocalization`, `bot_maxHealth`, `m_rawInput`, `gpad_enabled`, `gpad_present`, `gpad_in_use`, `gpad_debug`, `gpad_buttonsConfig`, `gpad_sticksConfig`, `gpad_rumble`, `gpad_stick_deadzone_min`, `gpad_stick_deadzone_max`, `gpad_button_deadzone`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_first`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_rest`, `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_min`, `gpad_menu_scroll_accel_time`, `input_invertPitch`, `cg_drawWatermark`, `cg_drawVersion`, `cg_drawVersionX`, and `cg_drawVersionY`.

`bot_maxHealth` defaults to `100` with domain `[1, 1000]`; `m_rawInput` defaults to `1`; `gpad_enabled` defaults to `1`; `gpad_present`, `gpad_in_use`, `gpad_debug`, and `input_invertPitch` default to `0`; `gpad_rumble`, `cg_drawWatermark`, and `cg_drawVersion` default to `1`.

`gpad_buttonsConfig` defaults to `buttons_default_alt`; `gpad_sticksConfig` defaults to `thumbstick_default`; `gpad_stick_deadzone_min` defaults to `0.2` with `[0.0, 1.0]`; `gpad_stick_deadzone_max` defaults to `0.01` with `[0.0, 1.0]`; and `gpad_button_deadzone` defaults to `0.13` with `[0.0, 1.0]`.

`gpad_menu_scroll_delay_first` defaults to `420` milliseconds with `[0, 1000]`; `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_rest` defaults to `210` milliseconds with `[0, 1000]`; `gpad_menu_scroll_delay_min` defaults to `50` milliseconds with `[0, 1000]`; and `gpad_menu_scroll_accel_time` defaults to `1500` milliseconds with `[0, 5000]`.

`cg_drawVersionX` defaults to `50.0` with `[-1024.0, 1024.0]`; `cg_drawVersionY` defaults to `18.0` with `[-1024.0, 1024.0]`; `cg_drawWatermark` describes the bottom-right Consolation watermark; and `cg_drawVersion` controls game-version rendering.

`component::post_load()` calls `replace_dvar()` for `g_speed = 210`, `ui_smallFont = 0.0`, `ui_bigFont = 0.0`, `ui_extraBigFont = 0.0`, and `cg_overheadNamesSize = 0.5`, all saved and bounded by `[0, 1000]` for `g_speed` or `[0.0, 1.0]` for the font/overhead scales.

#!/bin/sh

usage="Usage: $0 [-h|--help] [<options>] [<config>]"

# External toolchain defaults.
mn_ver="11.0.0"
mn_url="https://dl.winehq.org/wine/wine-mono"
mw_url="https://github.com/mstorsjo/msvc-wine.git"

# Cache and installation directories.
ca_dir="/tmp/msvc"
mi_dir="$HOME/.msvc"
wn_dir="$HOME/.wine"

# Build configuration (Debug or Release).
cfg="Debug"

owd="$(pwd)"
prog="$0"

fail ()
{
  cd "$owd" || true
  exit 1
}

diag ()
{
  if test $# -eq 0; then
    echo 1>&2
  else
    echo "$*" 1>&2
  fi
}

error ()
{
  diag "error: $*"
  fail
}

run ()
{
  diag "+ $*"
  "$@"
  if test "$?" -ne 0; then
    fail
  fi
}

check_cmd ()
{
  if ! command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    diag "error: unable to execute $1: command not found"
    if test -n "$2"; then
      diag "  info: $2"
    fi
    fail
  fi
}

yes=
clean=
deps=true
submods=true
verb=
force=
to=300
cto=30

bcfg=

while test $# -ne 0; do
  case "$1" in
    -h|--help)
      diag
      diag "$usage"
      diag "Options:"
      diag "  --yes               Don't ask for confirmation before starting."
      diag "  --clean             Remove existing wine and msvc installations before starting."
      diag "  --no-deps           Don't install system dependencies."
      diag "  --no-submodules     Don't update git submodules."
      diag "  --force             Perform a full bootstrap even if the environment is ready."
      diag "  --verbose           Print commands before they are executed."
      diag "  --cache-dir <dir>   Directory to cache downloaded msvc components (/tmp/msvc by default)."
      diag "  --msvc-dir <dir>    Directory to install the msvc toolchain (~/.msvc by default)."
      diag "  --wine-dir <dir>    Directory to use for the wine prefix (~/.wine by default)."
      diag "  --timeout <sec>     Network operations timeout in seconds (300 by default)."
      diag
      diag "By default this script builds the Debug configuration."
      diag
      diag "If the package manager requires root permissions to install system"
      diag "dependencies, sudo(1) will be used by default."
      diag
      diag "Options must come before the <config> argument."
      diag
      exit 0
      ;;
    --yes)
      yes=true
      shift
      ;;
    --clean)
      clean=true
      shift
      ;;
    --no-deps)
      deps=
      shift
      ;;
    --no-submodules)
      submods=
      shift
      ;;
    --force)
      force=true
      shift
      ;;
    --verbose)
      verb=true
      shift
      ;;
    --cache-dir)
      shift
      if test $# -eq 0; then
        error "directory expected after --cache-dir; run $prog -h for details"
      fi
      ca_dir="$1"
      shift
      ;;
    --msvc-dir)
      shift
      if test $# -eq 0; then
        error "directory expected after --msvc-dir; run $prog -h for details"
      fi
      mi_dir="$1"
      shift
      ;;
    --wine-dir)
      shift
      if test $# -eq 0; then
        error "directory expected after --wine-dir; run $prog -h for details"
      fi
      wn_dir="$1"
      shift
      ;;
    --timeout)
      shift
      if test $# -eq 0; then
        error "value in seconds expected after --timeout; run $prog -h for details"
      fi
      to="$1"
      shift
      ;;
    -*)
      diag "error: unknown option '$1'"
      diag "  info: run 'sh $prog -h' for usage"
      fail
      ;;
    *)
      bcfg="$1"
      shift
      if test $# -ne 0; then
        diag "error: unexpected argument '$1'"
        diag "  info: options must come before the <config> argument"
        fail
      fi
      break
      ;;
  esac
done

if test -n "$bcfg"; then
  case "$bcfg" in
    debug|Debug)     cfg="Debug"   ;;
    release|Release) cfg="Release" ;;
    *)
      error "invalid build configuration '$bcfg' (expected debug or release)"
      ;;
  esac
fi

if test "$verb" = true; then
  set -x
fi

prompt ()
{
  while test -z "$yes"; do
    printf "Continue? [Y/n] " 1>&2
    read -r yes
    case "$yes" in
      y|Y|"") yes=true ;;
      n|N)    fail     ;;
      *)      yes=     ;;
    esac
  done
}

download ()
{
  if test -n "$2"; then
    run curl -fL --connect-timeout "$cto" --max-time "$to" --progress-bar -o "$2" "$1"
  else
    run curl -fL --connect-timeout "$cto" --max-time "$to" --progress-bar -O "$1"
  fi
}

check_env ()
{
  if test "$force" = true; then

  fi

    return 1
  fi

sys_deps ()
{
  if test -z "$deps"; then
    return
  fi

  diag "info: detecting package manager"

  elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then pm=yum
  elif command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1; then pm=apt
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pm=pacman
  fi

  if test -z "$pm"; then
    error "unable to detect package manager (dnf, yum, apt, pacman)"
  fi

  diag "info: using package manager $pm"
